description:
Two statistics helpers are copy-pasted across the simulation binaries. Give each one a single home in the library and have every binary call it.

## Background

`mean_sigma` appears verbatim in four binaries, and a fifth inlines the same three-step computation without wrapping it. Separately, `ldpc_bler_sweep.rs:177` carries a private Es/N0-to-sigma conversion that duplicates the library's `channels::es_n0_db_to_sigma_f64`, differing only in return type.

Both are the same shape of debt in the same crate's binary layer, so they share one landing.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A single crate-internal `mean_sigma` is defined in the library and used by every binary that previously carried a copy.
- [hard] REQ-02: The binary that inlined the computation without a wrapper also calls the shared helper.
- [hard] REQ-03: No private copy of `mean_sigma` remains in any binary.
- [hard] REQ-04: The private Es/N0-to-sigma conversion in the BLER sweep binary is removed in favour of the library conversion, with any return-type difference handled at the call site or by a documented library variant.
- [hard] REQ-05: Reported statistics are numerically unchanged for a fixed seed.
- [hard] REQ-06: The workspace test suite, clippy with warnings denied, and formatting all pass.
title: Share the mean/sigma and Es/N0 conversion helpers across gf2-sim binaries
